headline: Chiefs defense stops the Colts
what_happened: D.Jones threw a pass that fell incomplete, meaning the Colts failed to gain any yards on this third down try.
who: D.Jones and F.Anudike-Uzomah were the key players.
why_it_matters: This is good news for the Chiefs because it makes it much harder for the Colts to score, decreasing their chances of winning by 8 percentage points.
